notes.title: Definitive Update Patch 1.4.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New[/h1]
Added:
-Godrays & Light beams
-Bloom
-60+ FPS Engine
-Upscaled the client resolution to 1920 x 1080
-Added photosensitive warning  
-Added background SFX on certain maps
-Added "intro" to world map, explaining certain mechanics

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased map size for smaller environments
[*]Removed pop-up dialogue images due to conflicts with the larger screen size
[*]Rewrote a few text boxes
[*]Added labels over locations on the world map
[*]Implemented "action button" travel on the world map; replacing old "touch to travel" system 
[*]The water in the underworld no longer damages the player
[*]Fixed a few event walk animations
[*]Fixed a few out of place events  
[*]Fixed some human events that were taller than others
[*]Changed some shadow placements
[*]Changed the main menu slightly 
[*]Updated the Northward Games logo
[*]Changed certain SFX to be quieter
[*]Fixed a few terrain objects that could be moved through
[*]Changed the UI to fit to a larger screen size
[/list]
- additional hotfixes

notes.title: Definitive Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[h2]The Update:[/h2]

This update will feature a few changes we decided to implement following our development on the sequel to Tales From Evenfall. We found a few things that we could package into a small update to improve the immersion and quality of life for the Tales From Evenfall experience.

The update will feature:

[*] Godrays & Light beams
[*] Bloom
[*] 60 FPS Engine
[*] Upscaled the client to 1920 x 1080
[*] Various minor bug fixes 
[*] Increased map size
[*] And much more!
[/list]


[h2]FAQ:[/h2]

Q: Do I need to pay for the update?
[list]
[*] No! The update will be entirely free. 
[/list]
Q: When will the update go live?
[list]
[*] The update will go live sometime later this week.
[/list]
Q: Why release it now?
[list]
[*] We originally intended this update to go live for the one year anniversary of Tales From Evenfall's release. However, we implemented changes faster than expected so this update can be released earlier! 
[/list]


[h2]Sequel Talk:[/h2]

Blood of The Alchemists, also known as the sequel to Tales From Evenfall will feature many of these elements built in for an increased layer of immersion and gameplay depth. We felt as though leaving Tales From Evenfall without some of these features wouldn't be fitting for the series.

 Be sure to follow the development thread on our website for more info on Blood of The Alchemists
[url=https://www.northwardgames.org/projects]underneath the "Projects" tab[/url] 

Once again we would like to thank everyone for their support of this game and our passion for game development here at Northward Games.

Cheers!

- The Northward Team

notes.title: Spooktober Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Embrace the Halloween spirit in a new free update for Tales From Evenfall out now!  The Spooktober
update brings an all new quest, new items, characters, dungeons and more! 

Embark on your journey into the haunted forest and help the fabled hero, Sir Daniel, retrace his steps to find the legendary sword, "The Davenarth Blade" and solve the mystery of his untimely demise.

[h2]Embark on an epic quest![/h2]
As Zeke, Miles and friends help Sir Daniel they'll explore a vast collection of brand new content coming to the game permanently, featuring:

[list]
[*]A spooky haunted Forest, full of dangerous foes!
[*]The old town of Mirewood
[*]New dungeons, items, characters and more!
[/list]

[h2]Beginning the Quest[/h2]
Find the mysterious stranger in the Verdyn Inn, he will give you a spooky skull, interact with it and begin your haunted journey!

Enjoy the Spooooky update and happy Questing!

-Northward Crew

notes.title: Spooktober Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
As autumn draws near, the Northward crew wanted to put out a special update to set the mood for Halloween. As Reaping day comes to Edina, a mysterious figure has been seen at the Verdyn Inn. He keeps to himself, but rumor has it that he holds a special relic, one full of dark magic and unknown power. 

Find him, and begin your journey into the haunted forest, an abandoned, cursed forest, lost in a distant land. Help the fabled hero, Sir Daniel retrace his steps to find the legendary sword, "The Davenarth Blade" and solve the mystery of his untimely demise.

[h2]Embark on an epic quest![/h2]
As Zeke, Miles and friends help Sir Daniel they'll explore a vast collection of brand new content coming to the game permanently, featuring:

[list]
[*]A spooky haunted Forest, full of dangerous foes!
[*]The old town of Mirewood
[*]New dungeons, items, characters and more!
[/list]

[h2]Release Date[/h2]
The update will be launching sometime from early-mid October for those wanting to celebrate some spooky spirit, and finish the quests before Halloween. The content will be standalone, meaning that you can begin it at any time and it will not change the course of the game. 

This update will be a small collection, and just our way of saying thanks, and giving back to those who have supported us so far. 

Happy Questing!

-Northward Crew
